issues.detail: Hebrew 'הַנֹּשְׁכִים בְּשִׁנֵּיהֶם' means 'who bite with their teeth' (i.e., using their teeth to bite), not '用象牙咬人' ('bite with ivory'). The Hebrew word for 'ivory' (שֵׁן) is not present; the text says 'teeth' (שִׁנֵּיהֶם). This changes the imagery from literal teeth to ivory, an addition not in the Hebrew.
